notes.title: Week One Patch! Major updates are LIVE now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45113700/2676cecbb383d3b207139da5c27c3f1afb5286b3.png

We are excited to share our latest patch, which now features an entirely new gameplay style. With a more in-depth design process for the mechanics, we have now immersed the players further into the tapes. We received a lot of feedback about players getting motion sickness due to the head-bob, well save that vomit for another day as we have removed that from the game. The original idea for the head-bob was to be more immersive with the recorder themselves, but it started to seem more of a burden than immersive, so it's gone! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45113700/04726e314da9442731912683d775c5419af170bf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45113700/c53976ab1cddc5c21c1b85243d8d254ca17bb6a0.png

Along with that, we got feedback that some of the searching and items seemed a little difficult to find, so we have conducted a diary system that will help guide players through each experience providing tips on where to locate things, and what each item could potentially be used for! With that being said, we have now also added in more jump-scares and eerie situations! With those new systems in place, we also added in a hiding system for players to hide in while being chased, this will help throw the killers off the trail and send them looking for you elsewhere, but beware, if they see you get into your hiding space, they can drag you out and end you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45113700/1d62426af27e0320d253c9513cf00adf5adbe450.png

We have really enjoyed all the amazing videos you have created, shared, uploaded and streamed! It's been a joy to watch you jump from scares or just immerse yourselves into the experiences. We look forward to seeing more great videos, and receiving more feedback! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45113700/a507757a31e0113117a85e23b1dd787e9e666157.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45113700/35e6d2019a4af6439426f46ee06c0944bb68e061.png


On a side note, more tapes will be releasing soon so stay tuned!
